question: Identify the German driver born between 1970 and 1990 who achieved the single fastest lap time across all Formula 1 races. For this driver, return their full name, nationality, date of birth, the name and year of the race where this fastest lap occurred, the circuit location and country, and the actual fastest lap time. Only consider laps where the driver finished the race (i.e., results.time IS NOT NULL).

    d.XCL_038 AS forename,
    d.XCL_039 AS surname,
    d.XCL_041 AS nationality,
    d.XCL_040 AS date_of_birth,
    r.XCL_069 AS race_name,
    r.XCL_066 AS race_year,
    c.XCL_004 AS circuit_location,
    c.XCL_005 AS circuit_country,
    res.XCL_088 AS fastest_lap_time
FROM drivers d
INNER JOIN results res ON d.XCL_034 = res.XCL_075
INNER JOIN races r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'German'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) BETWEEN '1970' AND '1990'
  AND res.XCL_084 IS NOT NULL
  AND res.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY res.XCL_088 ASC
LIMIT 1
